errors.evidence: The description lists two categories, green and purple, as if they are present in the pie chart. However, there are no green or purple slices visible; these categories have a 0% share.
The description incorrectly states there are no percentage labels, but the chart clearly shows percentage values (47.6%, 33.3%, 19%) inside each slice.
The color of the 19% slice is orange, not yellow ('жълто').
